properties.description: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/reasoning_crosses_designs_within_a_hub.rs drives the real binary as a registry behind a trusted gateway with a hub H over a proof design F and a citing design C: (1) C's claim, resting on a reference to F's theorem, reads shown through H and the premise names F and its proof status there; (3) a reference to a node F does not hold reads stale, and with F outside the readable set the premise reads unreachable, the claim unproven, and nothing F holds is revealed; (2) a walk from F's axiom through H names C's reference in boundary_crossings and carries C's radius under across_designs, and with C unreadable reveals nothing of C. All three failed first on main 62e9c84f3 (the premise read "computes no truth for a Resource", boundary_crossings []). crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_premise_in_another_design_reads_as_it_reads_there.rs holds the core's half: unreachable with nothing handed in; shown far keeps a confirmed line shown; proven far lets it be proven; holds_only_if makes it conditional; stale; fails; references_into.
properties.findings: 3 of 3 registry tests and 8 of 8 core tests pass on feat/reasoning-crosses-designs (c334a3f4a); the 3 registry tests failed on main 62e9c84f3 first, and the depth-1 crossing failed before c334a3f4a. AFTER, on the real designs: ef749c7f6e03a853 and 0bee0c00b35845f6 exported read-only from flo2.io (0.88.0) and served by this branch's binary as a local registry behind a gateway, under a local hub: calc's Fermat premise reads holds ("in design ef749c7f6e03a853 … its proof there: conditional"), the step holds, the claim reads conditional (it holds only if ef749c7f6e03a853:req:fermats-little-theorem says what it is recalled to say); with ef749 outside the readable set the premise reads unreachable; propagate_from on ef749c7f6e03a853:req:fermats-little-theorem at the default depth names 0bee0c00b35845f6:xref:ef749c7f6e03a853:req:a-fermat-test-failure-proves-n-composite in boundary_crossings, and calc's step reads unsupported under across_designs. BEFORE (flo2.io 0.88.0): "reflow2 computes no truth for a Resource", claim unproven, boundary_crossings [].
